title: Love of Kill
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Chateau Dankworth, a new bounty hunter, keeps running into Song Ryang-ha, a notorious hitman who stalks her and trades information for dates while repeatedly saving her from attackers. When both are targeted by Donald Bachmann, they confront a shared past: Chateau is the heir of a French aristocratic family whose escort she accidentally shot as a child, and the current Ryang-ha is a child-trafficking survivor who took that dead escort's name. An action romance in the criminal underworld.
life_message: People shaped by violence can still choose their own family and a bond of trust.

content.note: Frequent gunfights, assassinations and bloody combat; Ryang-ha single-handedly took down the Hong Kong triads; a child fatally shoots her escort (Wikipedia; AniList Gore 80, Guns, Assassins; MU Blood and Gore, Murder/s).
Kidnapping, hostage situations and torture-like captivity by Donald; dark ambience (MU Kidnapping/s, Hostage, Dark Ambience; Wikipedia: Chateau captured).
Romance between an adult hitman and a younger bounty hunter with sexual tension (MU Sexual Tension, Older Male Younger Female); MangaDex 'safe'.
Chateau fell into a catatonic state after the shooting; child trafficking trauma; MU Attempted Suicide and a spoiler-flagged AniList Suicide tag (Wikipedia; MU Traumatic Past).
Ryang-ha stalks Chateau and brokers her personal information in exchange for dates, framed as romantic pursuit (Wikipedia; MU Chasing After Love Interest; AniList Yandere).
